## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `open-loop-persistence`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-07-07T20:26:24.821Z.

Algorithm (11) open-loop tension scoring with decay floors (Zeigarnik persistence). Serves pm-vvib candidate subsystem (12): incomplete work must persist in assembled context until completed or deliberately parked, never fade under recency decay. Mechanism: maintain a per-agent open-loop registry — folded incrementally at write time (6) like all derived state — holding every loop the agent owns: claimed items, Decisions without recorded resolution, notes ending in unanswered questions, reviews awaiting reply. Each loop carries a tension score composed of deadline proximity, blocker fan-in (how many items the loop blocks — consumes the dep graph), decision-pending markers, and a claim-age shape that rises then plateaus, so ancient abandoned WIP hands off to stale-WIP hygiene (pm-w8q4) instead of dominating forever. Tension acts as a FLOOR under the salience scorer's decay term (1): an open loop's effective salience never drops below its tension, so it cannot be evicted by token-budget packing (4)/(9) while live. Release events — close, claim release, explicit parking (blocked-with-reason) — zero the floor and return the item to ordinary consolidation-managed scoring; each release is itself an entry in the immutable history stream, so the registry rebuilds exactly from replay. Bounded by design: the registry is capped per agent at working-memory scale (~7 loops, composing with chunking (9): overflow loops collapse under their parent chunk), so cost is O(active agents), independent of workspace size; sketch-backed state (8) is unnecessary here because the set is intrinsically small. Explainability (3): floored items render one line in --explain-ranking — held: open loop, claimed 3d ago, blocks 2, decision pending. Spectrum behavior: small workspaces never hit packing limits so the floor is a silent no-op; million-item thousand-agent workspaces guarantee every agent resumes with its own unfinished business first at zero scan cost. Distinct from (2) spreading activation (cue-driven associative boost; this is cue-INDEPENDENT persistence) and from (7) funnel quotas (source selection before fusion; this is a rank floor after fusion).

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
